about: Conformance vectors for the sales API (docs/sales-api.md, 'Conformance vectors'). Every client that recomputes the content hash, the approve message or the key fingerprint, or fills a dispatch prompt's note, must reproduce each 'expected' exactly. Computed once by the engine and pinned; the engine's tests assert these literals. If one ever has to change, the algorithm changed: change hashAlgorithm (HASH_ALGORITHM), approvePrefix (APPROVE_PREFIX), noteToken (NOTE_TOKEN) or the note line ('Note from Gabriel:', NOTE_LINE) with it.
hashAlgorithm: sha256 hex of JSON.stringify([lowercased trimmed toAddress, subject.trim(), body, rowName.trim(), step, gmailThreadId ?? "", answers ?? ""])
